note: Suggestions are NOT implemented. Choose one option per item before any change is made. Each option lists its cost and what it would change.

items.topic: Validate the submitted links and Tracking ID
items.question: How should the submitted links be validated?

options.label: Owner runs one link per product in the Associates Product Linking tool and reports destination + tracking
options.changes: Confirms FLG-001 to FLG-004; the site then uses validated Special Links for each row.

options.label: Keep the current observed-listing links with the Tracking ID until validation
options.changes: Already built. Links are unvalidated until option a is done.

options.label: Remove all outbound Amazon links until validated
options.changes: Lowest compliance risk; no click path to products.

items.question: How often should new guides be published?

options.label: Two guides per month, each reviewed against sources before publication
options.changes: Keeps content recent for Associates review; needs owner time.

options.label: Publish only after analytics shows which queries get reads

items.question: Which hosting and event set should analytics use?

options.label: Small serverless endpoint outside this repo, with the proposed five events
options.changes: Enables outbound-click counting; needs an external host and an endpoint URL.

options.label: Owner supplies a different five-event list
options.changes: Replaces the proposed events in site.json and analytics.js.

options.label: No analytics; use Search Console only

items.question: What should the site be called?

options.label: Owner supplies a name
options.changes: Changes masthead, footer and feed title.

items.question: How should listing details (dimensions, warranty, returns) be captured?

options.label: Owner or integration session records each field from the listing's Product information table with the date and URL
options.changes: Adds verified fields; blank fields stay flagged until then.

items.question: Should prices and ratings appear on the site?

options.label: Pursue PA-API/Creators API access, then display data per policy
options.changes: Requires eligibility and the API license; not verified here.

options.label: No prices or ratings; link to the listing
options.changes: Matches the current build; complies with Program Policies section 2(b).

options.label: Yes, double opt-in; Special Links allowed only in messages to opted-in readers, with an easy opt-out
options.changes: Adds a signup form and an email tool; not built.

items.topic: Which session's site goes to main
items.question: How should the parallel claim on arena/2b309a82-wina be handled?

options.label: Merge this branch to main as instructed; mark the other branch's claim as superseded in COORDINATION.md
options.changes: This site goes live. The other branch's site must be reconciled or closed before its work is merged, otherwise it conflicts.

options.label: Hold the merge until the owner has compared both COORDINATION.md boards
options.changes: Delays the live site; the merge instruction was to proceed without waiting.
